newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR softens across all maturities.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR softens across all maturities.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) fell across all maturities following the decline in their corresponding spot rates, traders said.
They said the cut in the Central Bank's overnight rates and the reduction in banks' reserve requirements would keep rates soft in the coming days.
The biggest declines were registered in the long end of the curve after Treasury bill rates fell at Monday's auction due to oversubscription.
PHIBOR are the average swap quotes of 20 banks operating in the country.
